items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: John Ringling of the Ringling Brothers Circus was a good friend of my Dad's.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. John Ringling of the Ringling Brothers Circus was a good friend of my Dad's. Every time Ringling Brothers came to Baton Rouge, he'd come and see my
Dad. My Dad once in a while made him a pair of shoes.
